query: 客户隐私保护政策 客户隐私保护政策 衡量企业在个人信息收集、使用、存储和共享方面的治理水平。重点考察“最小必要”原则的落地、用户授权机制、数据留存期限、第三方共享管理及隐私安全事件的应急响应。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的隐私政策，严格遵循“最小必要”原则；建立了动态授权与撤回机制；明确了数据留存与销毁时限；对第三方数据共享有严苛的审计要求，并披露了具体的隐私漏洞响应与补偿机制。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的隐私政策及用户协议，包含基础的收集与使用告知，具备数据加密等保护措施，但缺乏深度的第三方穿透管理、明确的留存期限或用户撤回授权的操作指南。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式隐私政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视信息安全”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：隐私保护机制覆盖 >80% 的业务线、APP/平台终端及经营地区，且通过了相关的外部审计（如 ISO 27701）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心 APP 具备政策而其他子业务线存在盲区，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 隐私政策 个人信息保护 最小必要 用户授权 数据留存 第三方共享 隐私事件响应 撤回同意 个人信息保护法 PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 privacy policy personal data protection data minimization user consent data retention third-party sharing privacy incident response PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 是否有正式客户/用户隐私政策或用户协议？ 是否披露个人信息收集和使用告知、最小必要原则及用户授权机制？ 用户能否撤回同意、注销账户、访问、更正或删除个人信息？ 是否采用数据加密、脱敏或访问控制？ 数据留存与销毁时限如何规定？ 第三方共享及SDK如何审核和约束？ 隐私事件响应、补偿、外部认证及覆盖范围是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '客户隐私保护政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式客户/用户隐私政策或用户协议？ 是否披露个人信息收集和使用告知、最小必要原则及用户授权机制？ 用户能否撤回同意、注销账户、访问、更正或删除个人信息？ 是否采用数据加密、脱敏或访问控制？ 数据留存与销毁时限如何规定？ 第三方共享及SDK如何审核和约束？ 隐私事件响应、补偿、外部认证及覆盖范围是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视信息安全”；仅有网络安全防火墙描述；仅有员工个人信息内控；仅有ISO 27001证书而无隐私政策要点；区分：客户隐私保护政策关注个人信息收集使用共享与用户权利；网络安全风险管理关注攻击监测拦截与应急；治理指标关注董事会层面网络风险监督，不能互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with customers
results.text: Ensuring customer privacy is also the basic principle of Ju Teng International. For customer privacy, Ju Teng International has always been committed to doing its best to safeguard all confidential information, personal information and intellectual property delivered by customers and other third-party companies to Ju Teng International, and employees only have limited access to customer codes or product codes, which fundamentally reduces the possibility of customer confidential information leakage. Besides, through the 'Business Ethics Management Procedure', the Group clarifies the management process of customer information and the standard process of collecting, storing, processing, and transmitting customer information, thus improving the confidentiality of customer privacy from the management system.

RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with customers

[Content]
Ensuring customer privacy is also the basic principle of Ju Teng International. For customer privacy, Ju Teng International has always been committed to doing its best to safeguard all confidential information, personal information and intellectual property delivered by customers and other third-party companies to Ju Teng International, and employees only have limited access to customer codes or product codes, which fundamentally reduces the possibility of customer confidential information leakage. Besides, through the 'Business Ethics Management Procedure', the Group clarifies the management process of customer information and the standard process of collecting, storing, processing, and transmitting customer information, thus improving the confidentiality of customer privacy from the management system.

results.text: Ju Teng International strictly complies with various environmental laws and regulations. On top of that, we established the internal management policies such as the 'Administrative Provisions of Environmental Protection', the 'Accountability System on Environmental Protection', the 'Management of Environmental Incidents' and the 'Environmental Factors and Hazardous Source Management Procedures' to manage possible negative environmental impacts in the production, maintenance, and service process in each Production Plant. All Production Plants of Ju Teng Group have obtained the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems Certification and IECQ HSPM 080000 Hazardous Substance Process Management Systems Certification.

[Section]
RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION

[Content]
Ju Teng International strictly complies with various environmental laws and regulations. On top of that, we established the internal management policies such as the 'Administrative Provisions of Environmental Protection', the 'Accountability System on Environmental Protection', the 'Management of Environmental Incidents' and the 'Environmental Factors and Hazardous Source Management Procedures' to manage possible negative environmental impacts in the production, maintenance, and service process in each Production Plant. All Production Plants of Ju Teng Group have obtained the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems Certification and IECQ HSPM 080000 Hazardous Substance Process Management Systems Certification.

results.text: Following the guiding principle of 'Do It Right at First Time', taking customer satisfaction as the goal and based on the ISO 9001 international quality standard, Ju Teng International formulated two whole process operation systems such as the 'Process Inspection and Testing Procedure' and 'Unqualified Product Control Procedure', as well as operational management systems such as 'Incoming Material Control Procedure', 'Measurement and Monitoring Procedure for Finished Product Quality Inspection', and 'Corrective and Preventive Measures Control Procedure'. Strict control is carried out in the whole process of incoming materials, finished products in storage and delivery, thus forming a complete product management system.

RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION

[Content]
Following the guiding principle of 'Do It Right at First Time', taking customer satisfaction as the goal and based on the ISO 9001 international quality standard, Ju Teng International formulated two whole process operation systems such as the 'Process Inspection and Testing Procedure' and 'Unqualified Product Control Procedure', as well as operational management systems such as 'Incoming Material Control Procedure', 'Measurement and Monitoring Procedure for Finished Product Quality Inspection', and 'Corrective and Preventive Measures Control Procedure'. Strict control is carried out in the whole process of incoming materials, finished products in storage and delivery, thus forming a complete product management system.

results.text: Ju Teng International formulated the 'Environment-Related Substance Reduction Plan Form', which imposes strict requirements on the suppliers to ban the use of heavy metals, formaldehyde, ozone hazardous substances, radioactive substances and so on. In order to restrict suppliers from using prohibited materials or chemical substances in the production process and on the products, parts and packaging materials provided to Ju Teng International, Ju Teng International has signed the 'Environmental Protection Agreement' with suppliers. In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.
